C_COD_CAUSES_DIAGNOSED.rationale: The response identifies all three core causes separately and provides a clear remedy for each: (1) calculating the discount amount rather than the discounted remainder (remedied by subtracting the percentage discount from the total), (2) reading only the first coupon code (remedied by looping over all codes and summing them), and (3) allowing coupons to drive the total to zero or negative (remedied by enforcing a floor/minimum charge).
